what: PRO-2 instance 8 fix, and the staged correction of the grammar oracle
why_staged: Two changes were pending at once -- a contract fix and an oracle correction. Measuring between them keeps attribution possible; doing both and reading one number would have lost the ability to say which caused what.
corpus: the SAME 606 enumerated combinations throughout; not expanded until this reproduces

stages.reading: 7 partial-honour hits are instance 8. All 177 disagreements are sheet_role=ignore -- the oracle's own modelling defect. Zero on data sheets.

stages.stage: B  contract fixed (role x transform pairing), oracle untouched
stages.reading: THE FIX WORKS: partial honour 7 -> 0. Disagreements ROSE by 14, all on data sheets, because the system now correctly refuses illegal pairings the oracle did not yet know were illegal.

stages.stage: C  oracle correction (a): learns the pairing rule
stages.reading: Data-sheet disagreements 14 -> 0. The total held at 191 because the SAME degeneracy widened by 14 on ignore sheets: the oracle now evaluated a pairing rule against a field the recipe does not contain.

stages.stage: D  oracle correction (b): ignore degeneracy, both sites
stages.reading: 606/606 agreement. The second site was the sheetset restriction, which the contract places on DATA entries and the oracle applied unconditionally -- an IGNORED sheetset is coherent and the system was right.

attribution.instance_8_closed_by: the contract fix (stage B), independently of any oracle change
attribution.the_177_and_191: oracle modelling defect, never system defects, and never on a data sheet
attribution.oracle_corrections_were_legitimate: (a) the oracle learned a rule because the LANGUAGE gained one; (b) the oracle stopped applying data-entry rules to non-data entries. Neither was a case of adjusting the oracle until the system agreed -- both were modelled from the contract, and stage B's rise in disagreements is the evidence that the oracle was not being tuned toward green.

not_expanded: Grammar coverage is deliberately NOT widened yet. The same corpus reproduces cleanly first; expanding now would change two things at once again.
